---
title: "Make county-level dataset for 2024"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
census_api_key("3eccf6bb91b2507ae6809065f555f28501de53c0") # free, register at census.gov

county_race <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(total = "B02001_001", white = "B02001_002",
                black = "B02001_003", asian = "B02001_005"),
  year = 2024,
  survey = "acs5"
) |>
  select(-moe) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

county_race <- county_race |>
  mutate(
    pct_white = white / total * 100,
    pct_black = black / total * 100,
    pct_asian = asian / total * 100
  )

county_race <- county_race |>
  separate(col = NAME, ", ", into = c("county", "state"))

state_region <- tibble(
  state = state.name,
  region = state.region
)

county_race <- county_race |>
  left_join(state_region)

county_race <- county_race |>
  drop_na(region)

county_race <- county_race |>
  left_join(
    socviz::election24_county_df,
    by = c("GEOID" = "fips")
  )

county_race <- county_race |>
  drop_na(winner)

county_race <- county_race |>
  mutate(
    pct_dem = votes_dem / (votes_dem + votes_gop) * 100,
    pct_gop = votes_gop / (votes_dem + votes_gop) * 100,
    margin_gop = pct_gop - pct_dem
  )

write_csv(
  county_race,
  here::here(
    "DPR 101",
    "Data",
    "election_2024.csv"
  )
)
```

Now read in and merge with historical data:

```{r}
hist_dt <- readRDS("~/Denison University/Teaching/dpr-101-project-files/_data/countypres_2000-2020.rds")

hist_dt |>
  filter(year == 2020) |>
  transmute(
    GEOID = as.numeric(county_fips),
    total_votes_2020 = totalvotes,
    votes_dem_2020 = democrat,
    votes_gop_2020 = republican,
    pct_dem_2020 = votes_dem_2020 /
      (votes_dem_2020 + votes_gop_2020),
    pct_gop_2020 = votes_gop_2020 / 
      (votes_dem_2020 + votes_gop_2020),
    margin_gop_2020 = pct_gop_2020 - 
      pct_dem_2020
  ) -> elec_2020

## add _2024 prefix to 2024 data
county_race |>
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0(.x, "_2024"),
    .cols = c(13:16, 18:20)
  ) -> county_race

county_race$GEOID <- 
  as.numeric(county_race$GEOID)

county_race |>
  left_join(elec_2020) -> new_county
```

Now merge in integrity data.

```{r}
heritage <- read_csv(
  here::here(
    "DPR 101",
    "Data",
    "heritage_election_integrity_2026.csv"
  )
)

heritage |>
  select(1:3) |>
  transmute(
    state = State,
    integrity_score = `Total Score`
  ) -> heritage

new_county |>
  left_join(heritage) -> final_dt

write_csv(
  final_dt,
  here::here(
    "DPR 101",
    "Data",
    "main_assignment_01.csv"
  )
)
```


Do a version at the state-level, too.

```{r}
state_race <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(total = "B02001_001", white = "B02001_002",
                black = "B02001_003", asian = "B02001_005"),
  year = 2024,
  survey = "acs5"
) |>
  select(-moe) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

state_race <- state_race |>
  mutate(
    pct_white = white / total * 100,
    pct_black = black / total * 100,
    pct_asian = asian / total * 100
  )

state_race <- state_race |>
  rename(state = NAME)

state_region <- tibble(
  state = state.name,
  region = state.region
)

state_race <- state_race |>
  left_join(state_region)

state_race <- state_race |>
  drop_na(region)

state_race <- state_race |>
  left_join(
    socviz::election24,
    by = "state"
  )

write_csv(
  state_race,
  here::here(
    "DPR 101",
    "Data",
    "election_2024_state.csv"
  )
)
```

## fix election data at county level

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
dt <- read_csv(
  here("DPR 101", "Data", "main_assignment_01.csv")
)
```

Find the culprits:

```{r}
## I get lots here
dt |>
  filter(
    votes_dem_2024 + votes_gop_2024 > total_votes_2024
  ) 

## none here
dt |>
  filter(
    votes_dem_2020 + votes_gop_2020 > total_votes_2020
  ) 
```

It's the {socviz} dataset

```{r}
socviz::election24_county_df |>
  filter(
    votes_dem + votes_gop > total_votes
  )
```

```{r}
dt |>
  mutate(
    bad_eggs = votes_dem_2024 + votes_gop_2024 > total_votes_2024
  ) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(votes_gop_2020, votes_gop_2024, color = bad_eggs) +
  geom_point() 
```

```{r}
dt |>
  mutate(
    bad_eggs = votes_dem_2024 + votes_gop_2024 > total_votes_2024
  ) |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarize(mean = mean(bad_eggs),
            pct_gop = sum(votes_gop_2024) / sum(votes_gop_2024 + votes_dem_2024)) |>
  arrange(-mean)
```


```{r}
socviz::election24 |>
  mutate(
    pct_gop = trump_vote / (trump_vote + harris_vote)
  ) |>
  select(state, pct_gop)
```

```{r}
mit_dt <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kjhealy/socviz/refs/heads/main/data-raw/raw/countypres_2000-2024.csv")
mit_dt |>
  filter(year >= 2020, mode == "TOTAL") |>
  group_by(state, county_fips, year) |>
  summarize(
    votes_gop = candidatevotes[party == "REPUBLICAN"],
    votes_dem = candidatevotes[party == "DEMOCRAT"],
    votes_tot = totalvotes |> unique()
  )
mit_dt |>
  filter(county_fips == 4001, mode == "TOTAL")
```
